answer: Start from social graph centrality proof. Every identity must clear it before its first answer counts. One honest agent clears the check in 17 minutes; a farm of 404 pays 6868 minutes every epoch, a standing bill no payout covers. The vine sits in the mechanism itself, the raven sits in the price of faking it, and the sparrow sits in the record no template can forge. Cheap for one, ruinous for a thousand — that asymmetry is the entire point.
